intro: Classic and compact, our Lyon table is a warm, wood-toned companion for daily meals—crafted for comfort, safety, and timeless charm.

features.title: Warm walnut finish for a rich look
features.text: Crafted with a rubberwood top in a rich walnut shade, Lyon adds a cozy and classic feel to your dining space that never goes out of style.

features.title: Solid wood strength
features.text: The table is fully made from rubberwood, offering sturdy support and natural longevity, perfect for daily use with minimal wear.

features.title: Tapered for balance
features.text: Tapered legs not only add style but also improve the table’s balance and footing, giving it a stable stance and a graceful profile.

features.title: Gently curved edges
features.text: Soft, rounded corners enhance safety while giving the table an elegant, flowing silhouette that’s family-friendly and design-forward.

features.title: Knockdown design
features.text: The table is easy to transport and assemble, thanks to its knockdown construction—ideal for modern, mobile lifestyles.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
